name: One Tama ~Boku to Onee-chan to Kitsune no Yu~
original_name: おね・たま～ボクとお姉ちゃんと狐の湯～
source: Yoshihisa, the heir of Onsen hotel, suddenly comes back to the hotel because the hotel is going to break down due to decreasing customers. Yoshihisa stands up to reinvigorate the hotel. First, he needs to choose a landlady.
